capabilities: Publish notes or selections to multiple social platforms
Schedule posts immediately, in the next free slot, or at a set time
Manage Typefully drafts, queue, and analytics from a sidebar panel
Attach vault images and videos to posts via auto-upload
Turn notes into styled social media image cards
extras: Full documentation lives outside the README; the API key is stored in Obsidian's secret storage rather than synced plugin data; requires Obsidian 1.13.0 or newer.
intentEvidence: integrates with Typefully to publish your notes as social media posts
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to turn notes into scheduled social media posts across multiple platforms.
